description: Defines the ServeCommand struct which implements a command-line interface for running the Swabble service, including configuration loading, speech stream processing, wake word detection, and logging.

classes.name: ServeCommand
classes.description: A command-line command for starting the Swabble speech service with configurable parameters.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Asynchronously runs the speech processing pipeline, handles wake word detection, and logs relevant events.

methods.name: matchesWake
methods.description: Checks if the provided text matches the configured wake word or its aliases.

methods.name: stripWake
methods.description: Removes the wake word or its aliases from the provided text.
